name: Investor Center [BETA]
desc:
[Latest Version 1.80 - COMEBACK UPDATE]
[Feel free to join us and give feedback . The game will be updated daily!]

They stole your credit. They blacklisted your name.
Now you’re starting again… with one goal: revenge  😈

In Investor Center, you begin small and build a brokerage empire through trading, upgrading, and smart expansion.
Turn your tiny office into a legendary powerhouse — the kind that prints money.

💹 Trade in a live shared stock market
🏢 Build and upgrade your office units
👥 Hire and upgrade staff to generate income over time
📊 Scale your earnings into absurd numbers
🏆 Complete goals, earn titles .

This isn’t just a tycoon.
It’s a climb.
And at the top… someone’s waiting for you. 👀


A solo-dev game by danielkaya
